scientific_integrity: Exact analytical derivations support the statements. Finite full-matrix tests corroborate rather than prove the parameter-uniform theorem. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only adjacency Hamiltonians on finite complete bipartite graphs with homogeneous positive loss on the entire monitored part and homogeneous projector dephasing are covered.
No result about finite-time hitting probabilities, nonuniform losses, onsite disorder, or multiparticle dynamics.
An implicit equivalent result in broader decoherence-assisted transport literature remains possible.
title: Dephasing-induced switching threshold for bright-state absorption on complete bipartite quantum networks
